def count_vowels(s):
    vowels = set('aeiou')
    total = sum(1 for c in s if c in vowels)
    extra = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(s):
        if c in vowels:
            left = i > 0 and s[i-1] in vowels
            right = i < len(s) - 1 and s[i+1] in vowels
            if left or right:
                extra += 1
    return total + extra
